authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current MHCLG Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset defines the area each local plan covers and exposes exact boundary references and polygon/multipolygon geometry; the official specification states local-plan records link to these boundary references. This source is suitable as coverage-area evidence once an authoritative slot selector exists. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan reference, local-plan-boundary reference, LPA/LAD identifier or name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any returned boundary would therefore be guessing. No coverage_area_id can be bound to the slot; no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
